topic.title: Is public Zebrahub data allowed as external training data?
topic.content:
Hi @thibautgoldsborough ,

Could you please clarify whether the publicly available Zebrahub imaging and tracking data can be used as external training data for this competition?

Zebrahub imaging data: https://zebrahub.sf.czbiohub.org/imaging

Specifically, I'd like to confirm whether both the imaging data and the tracking annotations (*_tracks.csv) are allowed.

Thanks!

comments.content: Hi! Yes you are free to use the data and all resources in Zebrahub for this competition! There is no overlap with the test set.
ZebraHub data allowed as external training data? @marumarukun
Following this thread. Clarification on external Zebrahub datasets (*_tracks.csv) would be very helpful!
